# QQMusicDES

`des.c` and `des.h` come from [wangqr/QQMusicDES](https://github.com/wangqr/QQMusicDES), which adapts Brad Conte’s DES implementation. The accompanying MIT license is bundled with LumiBar. The header guard has been corrected. LumiBar exposes only the QRC track decoding operation to Swift.
